name: Ancient Tome
landing_text: Welcome, seeker of ancient knowledge. This $(egyptian)tome$() contains the wisdom of the $(deity)Egyptian gods$() and the secrets of the $(curse)cursed lands$().$(br2)Within these pages, you will discover how to survive the harsh deserts, craft powerful artifacts, and face the guardians that protect the tombs of the pharaohs.
subtitle: A Guide to the Ancient Curse
